variables.title: Variables
variables.code:
x := 10 // immutable by default
mut y := 20 // mutable
y = 30
variables.notes: Variables are immutable by default in V. Use `mut` to make them mutable.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.code:
a := 1 // int
b := 2.0 // f64
c := true // bool
d := 'hello' // string
data_types.notes: V infers types. Strings use single quotes by convention.

operators.title: Operators
operators.code:
z := x + y
b := x > y
operators.notes: Standard arithmetic and logical operators are available.

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.notes: If statements do not require parentheses around the condition.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: V uses `in` with ranges for standard iteration.

while_loop.title: While Loop
while_loop.notes: V uses `for` for all loop types, including while loops.

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Functions are declared with the `fn` keyword.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.notes: Arrays are dynamic by default in V. Use `<<` to append elements.

maps.title: Maps
maps.notes: Maps have a literal syntax using curly braces.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: V uses `or` blocks for error handling with optional/result types.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: V uses C-style // single-line and /* */ multi-line comments.

numbers.title: Numbers & Numerics
numbers.notes: V provides explicitly sized integer and floating-point primitives with binary and hex support.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: V uses bool / boolean types with true and false literals and logical operators (&&, ||, !).

type_casting.title: Type Casting & Conversion
type_casting.notes: V supports explicit type casting using cast operators or constructor functions.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: V distinguishes between single-character literals and string sequences or pointer slices.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: V supports string interpolation or printf-style formatting specifiers.

pattern_matching.title: Pattern Matching & Switch
pattern_matching.notes: V evaluates branching conditions through switch statements, match expressions, or when constructs.

range.title: Ranges & Slicing
range.notes: V represents ranges with range operators (.., ..<) or standard indexed iteration boundaries.

iterators.title: Iterators & Sequences
iterators.notes: V implements iteration through Iterator interfaces, generators, or range-for loops.

oop_classes.title: Classes & OOP
oop_classes.notes: V models object orientation through classes with constructors/encapsulation or structs with associated methods.

lists.title: Dynamic Arrays & Lists
lists.notes: V manages growable dynamic collections using vectors, ArrayLists, or dynamically reallocated heap buffers.

tuples.title: Tuples & Records
tuples.notes: V represents heterogeneous records through tuples, structured bindings, or lightweight record structs.

sets.title: Sets & Unique Collections
sets.notes: V provides unique collection hashing structures with O(1) average lookup and insertion time.

modules_import.title: Modules, Packages & Imports
modules_import.notes: V structures namespaces and external libraries via include directives, package declarations, or module imports.
